title: Check whether monitoring-disposition confirmation should publish the merged public test-run card
outcome: It is decided, with a behavioural test, whether the monitoring-disposition confirmation path in src/test_run_observations.rs (about line 440), which finishes a pending row as durable, publishes the merged public card (test_run_public_observation) for a row merged into a launcher artifact, instead of the raw provider-row summary. If the raw summary can put the provider-only row back next to its card in the client, the path publishes the public card.
acceptance: Check whether monitoring-disposition confirmation should publish the merged public test-run card is done
